description.value: Quality Foods is a Vancouver Island–based supermarket chain, and this Qualicum Beach location offers a full range of grocery departments including fresh produce, bakery, deli, and household goods. It serves as a well-stocked resupply point for touring cyclists on the Island's east coast route. The deli and ready-made meals section provides a convenient option for riders looking for quick, ready-to-eat food.

There is a notable name discrepancy: OSM records the business as 'Qualicum Foods' while the website brand is consistently 'Quality Foods' (qualityfoods.com). No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms, etc.) are mentioned anywhere in the fetched website content, so those fields default to null.
